verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say it is "grounded in your knowledge base" (on the Voice page), list escalation guidance and rules, and offer tools to "safely deploy AI within your own boundaries." These point toward knowledge-bound answers with escalation, but there is no explicit description of declining or refusing off-knowledge questions or of blocking invented policies, prices or promises. Missing for 10: documented off-knowledge decline/refusal behavior, explicit anti-hallucination guardrails for policies, prices and commitments, detail beyond help-article titles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, guardrails stop the agent from inventing policies, prices, or promises — off-knowledge questions get a safe decline, not a guess
